productionGoLiveRule: Every control with gate=true must have status=pass and non-empty evidence in the deployment evidence file.

controls.requirement: Engine production image is pinned by immutable sha256 digest; the production database is either pinned by immutable image digest when self-managed or has its managed-service resource identity, provider, region, and database major version captured in deployment evidence.
Production secrets come from an approved secrets manager; protected-data key custody, backup, rotation and break-glass procedures are documented.
Administrative/staff routes are protected by an approved MFA-capable identity/access gateway. The current engine does not provide native MFA/IdP.
TLS termination, WAF/volumetric controls, and trusted proxy header overwrite are verified.
Database is not publicly reachable and application/worker egress is default-deny except approved DNS/HTTPS destinations; cloud metadata and private networks are blocked.
An approved scanner/sandbox is connected and a clean result is required before uploaded content becomes evidence.
Encrypted database backup and restore test completed with approved RPO/RTO.
Encrypted document-store backup and restore test completed with integrity verification.
Container/security logs and immutable audit events are ingested into the approved SIEM with alert tests.
Authorized penetration test completed; no unresolved critical/high finding is accepted for go-live.
Manual end-to-end accessibility review completed against the production thin application, targeting WCAG 2.1 AA.
Records officer approved retention/disposition schedule or explicitly approved hold-by-default mode for launch.
Incident response contacts, credential/key compromise procedures, evidence preservation, and notification paths are exercised.
Deployment owner acknowledges that this application is unclassified-only and is not an accredited classified system or substitute for an ATO.
